specification.description: Authoritative semantic interpretation contract for KDI AI Search V3

layers.name: Asset Identity & Provenance
layers.meaning: Canonical asset identity, source lineage, technical identity, rights context, and assertion origin.

layers.name: Global Asset Understanding
layers.meaning: Asset-level content type, synopsis, primary subject, purpose, and overall interpretation.

layers.name: Temporal / Scene Structure
layers.meaning: Time-based segmentation, scenes, events, keyframes, and their exact asset locations.

layers.name: People & Roles
layers.meaning: Visible or supported people, identity status, participant roles, and role evidence.

layers.name: Person Appearance
layers.meaning: Evidence-based per-person visible appearance attributes without unsupported identity inference.

layers.name: Anatomy
layers.meaning: Canonical anatomical regions and their observed, discussed, examined, or treated relationships.

layers.name: Treatment / Procedure
layers.meaning: Canonical treatments, procedures, stages, and their relationship to the asset or scene.

layers.name: Actions & Events
layers.meaning: Actions and events, participants, targets, and time/evidence scope.

layers.name: Relationships
layers.meaning: Evidence-supported interactions and relationships among people, actions, anatomy, and treatments.

layers.name: Clinical Visual Observations
layers.meaning: Visible clinical observations explicitly separated from diagnoses and medically verified facts.

layers.name: Environment
layers.meaning: Location, setting, surroundings, activity, and visible environmental qualities.

layers.name: Cinematography
layers.meaning: Shot size, angle, camera motion, focus, lighting, visual style, and technical visual qualities.

layers.name: Composition
layers.meaning: Subject placement, negative space, safe areas, clutter, logo visibility, and compositional qualities.

layers.name: Speech / Transcript / Audio
layers.meaning: Speech, transcript, speakers, language, audio events, topics, and exact timing.

layers.name: OCR / Visible Text
layers.meaning: Visible text, captions, labels, signs, devices, language, and exact visual/time location.

layers.name: Marketing & Content Usage
layers.meaning: Descriptive content roles, possible uses, funnel stages, and suitability; never usage permission by inference.

layers.name: Semantic Narrative
layers.meaning: Evidence-grounded literal, clinical-visual, storytelling, marketing, and emotional interpretations.

layers.name: Search & Embeddings
layers.meaning: Search documents, concepts, vector representations, model identifiers, and retrieval-facing semantic material.

information_states.meaning: There is sufficient evidence supporting the value.
The concept was evaluated and evidence supports that it is not present or false.
The system cannot determine the value reliably from available evidence.
The concept does not logically apply to that asset or context.

relevance_grades.meaning: The asset strongly satisfies the important query requirements.
The asset is clearly relevant but may miss a secondary or preference-level condition.
The asset relates to the query but does not satisfy enough conditions to be considered strong.
The asset does not meaningfully satisfy the search request.
The asset contains evidence directly conflicting with an explicit query requirement.

ontology_contract.frozen_scope: Current live approved controlled concepts; Phase 1 performs no ontology expansion or row mutation.

fingerprint_contract.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with lexicographically sorted object keys and separators comma/colon; omit specification.specification_fingerprint only

legacy_definitions.reason: Its 18 names and order differ materially from semantic_index_v1; Phase 1 preserves the table without mutation.
